title: The Scutellaria baicalensis-Coptis chinensis herb pair ameliorates ulcerative colitis via integrated modulation of the aryl hydrocarbon receptor/NLRP3 inflammasome axis with tryptophan metabolites.
authors: Fang, Dan; Sheng, Xianjie; Li, Xinru; Tan, Bingyan; Zhang, Jingyan; Ding, Kang; Kang, An
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药药对通过AHR/NLRP3轴治疗溃疡性结肠炎，仅涉及分子对接筛选配体，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The Scutellaria baicalensis Georgi and Coptis chinensis Franch (SC) herb pair constitutes a vital component‌ in many classic formulas exhibited well-documented synergistic therapeutic efficacy against bacterial infections and various inflammatory conditions. However, the precise mechanism of this herb pair in treating ulcerative colitis (UC) is unknown. PURPOSE: To investigate the therapeutic potential and elucidate the mechanistic basis of SC herb pair treating UC. METHODS: A dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced UC mouse model was established to evaluate the therapeutic effect of SC herb pair. Colonic inflammation, tight junction proteins, NOD-like receptor protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome, and the Aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR) - Cytochrome P450 1A1 (CYP1A1) axis were assessed. AHR activation by principal bioactive compounds in SC was verified, while endogenous AHR ligands affected by SC herb pair treatment were monitored by HPLC-MS. The role of AHR in suppressing NLRP3 inflammasome activation and mediating SC herb pair's therapeutic effects was validated using the AHR antagonist CH223191 and AHR-knockout (AHR(-/-)) mice. RESULTS: Compared with the UC model, SC herb pair administration effectively alleviated the weight loss, colon shortening and mucosal injury. It also markedly suppressed mRNA levels of pro-inflammatory mediators (IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF-alpha), as well as the protein expression of iNOS and COX-2, and inhibited the NLRP3 inflammasome activation, a key driver of UC pathogenesis. SC herb pair enhanced tight junction protein expression in colitis mice and upregulated AHR and its target gene CYP1A1 in colitis mice. Luciferase assays confirmed direct activation of AHR by key bioactive ingredients in SC screened by molecular docking. Additionally, SC herb pair treatment restored tryptophan metabolite (kynurenine and indole-3-acetic acid) homeostasis and these metabolites also could activate AHR signaling. Crucially, both pharmacological inhibition with CH223191 and genetic ablation of AHR abrogated the beneficial effects of SC herb pair in UC mice. CONCLUSION: The SC herb pair ameliorates UC thorough AHR activation, which is achieved both directly via its bioactive constituents and indirectly through the restoration of AHR-activating tryptophan metabolites. Subsequently, AHR activation suppresses the NLRP3 inflammasome-driven colonic inflammation and restores intestinal barrier, thereby providing a mechanistic basis for its therapeutic effects against UC.
abstract_zh: 背景：黄芩（Scutellaria baicalensis Georgi）与黄连（Coptis chinensis Franch）药对（SC）是许多经典方剂中的重要组成部分，已有充分文献记载其对细菌感染及多种炎症性疾病具有协同治疗功效。然而，该药对治疗溃疡性结肠炎（UC）的确切机制尚不明确。目的：探讨SC药对治疗UC的治疗潜力并阐明其机制基础。方法：建立葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的UC小鼠模型，评估SC药对的治疗效果。检测结肠炎症、紧密连接蛋白、NOD样受体蛋白3（NLRP3）炎症小体及芳基烃受体（AHR）-细胞色素P450 1A1（CYP1A1）轴。验证SC中主要生物活性化合物对AHR的激活作用，并通过HPLC-MS监测SC药对处理影响的内源性AHR配体。使用AHR拮抗剂CH223191和AHR基因敲除（AHR(-/-)）小鼠，验证AHR在抑制NLRP3炎症小体激活及介导SC药对治疗效果中的作用。结果：与UC模型相比，SC药对给药有效缓解了体重下降、结肠缩短和黏膜损伤。它还显著抑制了促炎介质（IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α）的mRNA水平，以及iNOS和COX-2的蛋白表达，并抑制了NLRP3炎症小体激活——这是UC发病机制的关键驱动因素。SC药对增强了结肠炎小鼠中紧密连接蛋白的表达，并上调了结肠炎小鼠中AHR及其靶基因CYP1A1。荧光素酶实验证实，通过分子对接筛选出的SC关键生物活性成分可直接激活AHR。此外，SC药对处理恢复了色氨酸代谢物（犬尿氨酸和吲哚-3-乙酸）的稳态，这些代谢物也能激活AHR信号通路。关键的是，CH223191的药理学抑制和AHR的基因敲除均消除了SC药对在UC小鼠中的有益效果。结论：SC药对通过AHR激活改善UC，这一激活既通过其生物活性成分直接实现，也通过恢复AHR激活型色氨酸代谢物间接实现。随后，AHR激活抑制了NLRP3炎症小体驱动的结肠炎症并恢复肠道屏障，从而为其抗UC治疗效果提供了机制基础。
